### PtTe2、NbTi量子輸運參數表 {#subsection-quantum-transport-parameters-table}

+------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+----------------------+-------------+
| **參數**                           | **符號**                                                | **NbTi**           | **PtTe2**            | **單位**    |
+:==================================:+:=======================================================:+:==================:+:====================:+:===========:+
| **費米速度\                        | $v_{F}$                                                 | ≈ 1.25--1.55       | $3.3 \times 10^{-5}$ | m/s         |
| Fermi velocity**                   |                                                         |                    |                      |             |
+------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+----------------------+-------------+
| **平均碰撞時間\                    | $\tau$                                                  | ≈ 10⁻¹²--10⁻¹¹     | ≈ 10⁻¹²--10⁻¹¹       | s           |
| Mean free time**                   |                                                         |                    |                      |             |
+------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+----------------------+-------------+
| **擴散係數\                        | $D = v_{F}^{2}\frac{\tau}{2}$                           | ≈ 5.6×10²--5.6×10³ | ≈ 1.5×10²--2.4×10³   | cm²/s       |
| Diffusion coefficient**            |                                                         |                    |                      |             |
+------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+----------------------+-------------+
| **電阻率\                          | $\rho = \left\lbrack n_{s}e\mu_{e} \right\rbrack^{- 1}$ | ≈ 0.001--0.01      | ≈ 0.0002--0.002      | kΩ (per □)  |
| Resistivity** ¹                    |                                                         |                    |                      |             |
+------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+----------------------+-------------+
| **費米波長\                        | $\lambda_{F} = 2\frac{\pi}{k_{F}}$                      | ≈ 0.32 nm          | ≈ 7--11 nm           | nm          |
| Fermi wavelength**                 |                                                         |                    |                      |             |
+------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+----------------------+-------------+
| **平均自由路徑\                    | $l_{e} = v_{F}\tau$                                     | 80--800            | 180                  | nm          |
| Mean-free path**                   |                                                         |                    |                      |             |
+------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+----------------------+-------------+
| **載子遷移率\                      | $\mu_{e} = \frac{v_{F}}{l_{e}}$                         | ≈ 1.25--1.55       | ≈ 6.5--7.5           | cm²/Vs      |
| Electron mobility**                |                                                         |                    |                      |             |
+------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+----------------------+-------------+
| **狄拉克點\                        | $E_{D}$                                                 | ≈ 0.32 eV          | ≈ 0.32 eV            | eV          |
| Dirac point**                      |                                                         |                    |                      |             |
+------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+----------------------+-------------+
| **超導相干長度\                    | $\xi$                                                   | ≈ 10 nm            | ≈ 10 nm              | nm          |
| Superconducting coherence length** |                                                         |                    |                      |             |
+------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+--------------------+----------------------+-------------+

: PtTe2、NbTi量子輸運參數表
